final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS wp, t.bandusagepct AS b FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1), g AS (SELECT wp, AVG(b) AS avg_bw, COUNT(*) AS n_tel FROM j GROUP BY wp), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_bw) OVER () AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT wp AS weathprofile, avg_bw AS avg_bandusagepct, n_tel AS telescope_count, avg_bw - mean_avg AS diff_from_mean FROM m WHERE mean_avg IS NOT NULL
